clips.title: The story
paras: At Steelgrill's Depot, Loslor Rudge keeps Dun Morogh's tinkerers supplied. His tools, parts, and munitions reach craftsmen across the snowy ridges, including gunsmith Hegnar Rumbleshot.

Loslor Rudge supplies engineering goods from Steelgrill's Depot, just down the road from Kharanos. His stock includes copper modulators, bronze tubing, blasting powder, and spanners. Harsh weather and scattered tinker operations keep practical parts in demand, and Loslor works to keep local gearheads supplied. The wilderness between outposts makes deliveries perilous. A courier taking a shortcut near the Grizzled Den was driven off by wendigos, leaving behind an ammunition shipment meant for Loslor's valued client, gunsmith Hegnar Rumbleshot.
